scope: Presentation of ten existing reviewed 2026 Pennsylvania county participation observations and one separately scoped D.C. county-equivalent observation

native_records: All original CSV fields retained as strings, including blanks, zeroes, false literals, accounting fields and separate timestamps
native_printed_fractions: Separate from calculated fractions; missing native printed values remain null
native_result_status: Chester's missing native literal remains empty; no universal native unofficial label is invented

timestamps: Preserve native update labels, separate generation/publication observations and absent timezone declarations
monroe_identity: reviewed:PA:Monroe is an internal selector identity, not an invented native county FIPS
dc_scope: Citywide county-equivalent participation, separate from the 435 voting House districts; 324-ballot delegate-accounting difference unallocated; native early zero/false flags do not establish zero early voters
downloads: Existing immutable complete participation CSVs and parent packages; all nine ZIPs and 73 registered tables publicly byte-verified; exact 288-URL / 291-anchor download multiset unchanged
production_status: Pending exact deployment and source-matched production verification
